Jagan Mohan Reddy on Friday accused the NDA government in the state of not honouring the Supreme Court directives in connection with the conduct of local body elections and sought an appointment of an amicus curiae to supervise the polls.

candidates.title: Andhra Pradesh Intermediate Exams 2027: Tentative Schedule Released
candidates.excerpt: The theory examinations for both years are scheduled to continue until March 16. Regular, backlog and eligible old-syllabus students will write their examinations from 9 am to 12 noon, according to the papers allotted to them.

candidates.title: Habit-forming drug misuse raises concern across Hyderabad and Telangana
candidates.excerpt: The misuse of habit-forming medicines is raising concern in Hyderabad and other urban areas of Telangana. While enforcement agencies target illegal sales at medical shops, experts stress the need to expand rehabilitation services and address the psychological pressures underlying substance misuse

candidates.title: KTR blames Congress for drought-like conditions in Telangana, alleges irrigation projects remain idle
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao has blamed the Congress government for drought-like conditions in Telangana, alleging that major irrigation projects remain idle despite substantial Krishna and Godavari inflows. He said farmers are struggling to save crops and buying tanker water.

candidates.title: BJP MLA Payal Shankar Calls Congress Cockroaches, Accuses Party of Misleading People
candidates.excerpt: Shankar further questioned the Congress party's political standing and alleged that it was attempting to mislead people while avoiding accountability under its own name.

candidates.title: Tibet earthquake updates | Injuries in Tibet rise to 65 after 7.0 earthquake, death toll at 16
candidates.excerpt: Search and rescue efforts continued following the collapse of at least 339 homes, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials. Among the injured, 11 people were in serious condition, and the other 21 sustained minor injuries, the media office said

candidates.title: What is Romanch’s Law? New York City’s historic horse carriage ban after Indian tourist’s death
candidates.excerpt: The New York City Council voted to pass Romanch’s Law, a landmark measure that bans horse-drawn carriages from city streets and Central Park by June 1, 2028, in a move championed by Mayor Mamdani after an Indian tourist died following a carriage accident in Central Park

candidates.title: Let’s Make Kodangal Model for India, Says Revanth
candidates.excerpt: Railway link, industrial park, temples and healthcare projects to drive Kodangal’s development.

candidates.title: Alai Balai brings leaders across party lines together
candidates.excerpt: Governor flags drug menace; Venkaiah Naidu says programme promotes brotherhood beyond caste, religion and politics
